text:
sam: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need to update the runbook for cache-eviction patterns and make action owners + deadlines explicit. Short plan below.

elaine: +1. can we split into triage checklist, diagnostics, escalation, and recurring-detection?

sam: Exactly. Proposed owners: sam = runbook edits (triage checklist + mitigation), elaine = escalation flow & stakeholder contact list, raj = alert rules & dashboards. ops-bot will link the postmortem.

raj: I'll handle alerts. Proposed PromQL to detect recurring pattern: `count_over_time(inference_cache_evictions[24h]) by (region, customer_tier) > 3` — that'll be the basis of a rolling alert.

sam: Good. Diagnostics snippet to include in runbook (please copy into the doc):
```
# pod CPU/mem pressure
kubectl top pods -n inference
# redis evictions
redis-cli -h $REDIS_HOST INFO memory | grep evicted_keys
# recent runtime logs
kubectl logs deploy/inference-runtime -n inference --tail=300
```

elaine: For escalation: on-call -> eng-sre lead (10m) -> infra pager (30m) -> CTO on-call (60m). I'll add phone + slack rota links. Also add a canary rollback step: how to pin model_version in the route config.

sam: Mitigation steps to capture: 1) temporarily increase cache TTL for high-priority routes; 2) run cache warm-up job for prefixes; 3) scale up dedicated pool if within SLA. Add exact kubectl HPA commands in runbook.

raj: I'll open the alert PR and a dashboard tile for evictions by region. ETA: Wed EOD.

ops-bot: Linked postmortem: https://redwood/internal/postmortems/2365009001-cache-evict-patterns.json

sam: Timeline: initial PRs from owners by Thu, review by Fri, merge + publish by next Mon. Weekly remediation check-ins until items closed.

elaine: I'll draft the escalation doc and include the blameless wording.

raj: adding runbook link to the alert so playbook is a click away.

sam: If anyone hits a blocker post here. Thanks! :thumbsup:
